attributes.board_name: North Carolina State Board of Dental Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: ADA CERP-recognized sponsors; AGD; NC AHEC; dental/dental hygiene/dental assisting schools; national, state or local societies; government entities; FQHCs. Must relate to clinical patient care
rules.new_licensee_rule: Dentists licensed after Jan 1, 2019 who practice or teach in NC take a 6-hour professionalism and ethics course in their first CE year (counts toward the 15 h).
rules.audit_note: Hours reported on the annual renewal application; keep sponsor reports for at least 2 years and produce them at Board audit.

topics.who: Dentists who prescribe controlled substances (incl. chronic pain prescribing)
Current CPR; CPR hours do not count

rules.notes: Annual renewal by Jan 31; void if not compliant by Mar 31. All hours may be self-study from approved sponsors (test required). 1 h mental health/substance use CE every two calendar years (no matching topic code). Current CPR required; CPR hours do not count.
